user.title: Log Notifier
user.description: Set up Log Notifier. Channels are added afterwards under Configure.

abort.already_configured: Log Notifier is already set up.

add_channel.title: Add channel
add_channel.description: The ingest token is generated automatically. The channel's URL is listed afterwards under Show URLs.

data_description.mqtt_topic: Messages published to this topic land in the channel, in the same format as over HTTP. Wildcards (+, #) are allowed. Suggested: lognotifier/ followed by the channel ID, for example lognotifier/backups — pre-filled when editing a channel if the MQTT integration is set up. Leave empty for HTTP only.

show_urls.title: Ingest URLs
show_urls.description:
{urls}

Every URL contains its channel's token — treat it like a password. An MQTT topic has no token: who may publish to it is up to the broker.

edit_channel.title: Channel {name}
edit_channel.description:
Ingest URL: {url}

The name applies everywhere — to the device, the entities and the card. Renaming the device instead has the same effect.

data_description.mqtt_topic: Messages published to this topic land in the channel, in the same format as over HTTP. Wildcards (+, #) are allowed. Suggested: lognotifier/ followed by the channel ID, for example lognotifier/backups — pre-filled when editing a channel if the MQTT integration is set up. Leave empty for HTTP only.

error.invalid_topic: This is not a valid MQTT topic filter.
error.duplicate_topic: Another channel already uses this topic.

send.name: Send message
send.description: Adds a message to a channel.

content.name: Content
content.description: Message text, Discord-style markdown. Optional when blocks are given.

blocks.name: Blocks
blocks.description: Text, label/value grids and tables below the content, in any order: a text block is a string, a grid is an object with rows, a table is an object with columns and rows or a table given as a list of objects.

mark_read.name: Mark as read
mark_read.description: Sets the read marker; without a channel it applies to all.

clear.name: Clear channel
clear.description: Removes all messages of a channel.
